_comment: db-pro calibration for tools/cc-scan.py (vendored from truongnat/clean-code-skills). Every non-default value below carries a reason — tune thresholds to this codebase's conventions, never to hide findings.
_reason_skipRules: MAGIC_NUMBER fires inside `const` declarations and all over egui painting geometry (the pack itself skips it in tools/clean-code.config.json). DEBUG_STATEMENT is already gated by .skills/clean-code/scripts/clean-code-scan.sh which blocks println!/dbg!/eprintln! outside tests. BOOLEAN_PARAM flags idiomatic per-frame display flags on egui draw calls (is_running, enabled, selected); the rule targets business-logic mode switches, and these sites are not that.
_reason_ignoreDirs: _archive is frozen reference code; docs/evidence/screenshots hold no source; tools holds the vendored scanners themselves; fixtures are test-data generators, not product code.
_reason_minTestRatio: Rust keeps tests in inline #[cfg(test)] modules, not separate files — the file-ratio metric cannot see them.
_reason_maxParams: A Rust view/service fn naturally carries (ctx, ui, state) plus one subject parameter = 4; the default of 3 is calibrated for GC languages where context is implicit. hardParams stays at 5 — 6+ params still error.
_reason_maxFunctionLines: Rust match arms and struct literals spend lines without spending branches; pack rule #2 says linear transformations may exceed the line budget while branch density is what costs money. hardFunctionLines stays at 70 — anything past 70 is still an error.
_reason_maxNesting: if-let/while-let chains and match arms each burn one nesting level in Rust; depth 4 is one honest level deeper than the TS default. Depth 5+ is still flagged.
_reason_skipRulesForTests: Pack defaults plus DEEP_NESTING/DUPLICATE_BLOCK/BOOLEAN_PARAM: nested arrange-act-assert, repeated fixture setup, and boolean parameters are idiomatic in tests and cost nothing to read. HARD_COMPLEXITY/HARD_PARAMS still apply inside tests.
